spanish: oráculo del oyente dichos de El, que visión de Shadai contempla, caído y descubierto de ojos:

findings.issue: אֵל is a common noun (HNcmsa), not a proper name; «El» leaves that lemma untranslated instead of a Spanish common noun.
נֹפֵל is a qal active participle; «caído» states a completed result rather than the active falling.

notes: Remaining tokens match in number, person, and construct links, including dual עֵינָיִם as ojos.
